definition: below every other place, at the bottom
description: A limbo game on a sandy beach at dusk. A young man in an open light blue shirt, white T-shirt and navy shorts bends his knees deeply and leans far back to get under a thin bamboo pole between two tall wooden posts, his arms stretched out. A young woman in a green top kneels by one post and watches. Friends in swimwear behind him cheer with their arms in the air, and a young woman in a purple top jumps up and shouts. A thatched beach bar with string lights stands behind under a pink and blue sky.

taps.phrase: to bend backwards under the pole
